channel.title: PHP Ledger news
channel.description: PHP Ledger is open-source, self-hosted double-entry accounting software with core invoices, bills and payments, optional purchasing and inventory, and a manually configured tax engine. Built on PHP 8.2+ with MySQL 8.4 or MariaDB 10.4+, 1.1.0 is the current release: unzip it into any web folder, open it, and the browser installer starts; updates are publisher-signed. 1.0.0 was the first stable release; independent accounting and security review remain post-release commitments.

item.title: PHP Ledger 1.1.1: setup you can watch
item.description: PHP Ledger 1.1.1 rebuilds browser setup into six stages with green and red checks, and accepts a local database account with no password.

item.title: PHP Ledger 1.1.0: install from any web folder
item.description: PHP Ledger 1.1.0 installs like WordPress from any web folder, supports MariaDB 10.4+, lets the first account choose a username and adds an optional logo.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.6.0-preview: a rebuilt accounting workspace
item.description: A focused Home, compact registers, reviewed document editors, multi-item settlements and gross-profit reporting in PHP Ledger 0.6.0-preview.

item.title: PHP Ledger 1.0.0: the first stable release
item.description: PHP Ledger 1.0.0 consolidates workflow recovery, a browser installer and signed automatic updates with backup/recovery into the first supported stable release.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.3.0: parties, currency and correction foundations
item.description: PHP Ledger 0.3.0 prepares parties, currency snapshots, open items and corrections for future invoice and bill workflows, with tested upgrade evidence.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.4.0: an accounting starter for invoices, bills and stock
item.description: Try PHP Ledger's accounting starter: core invoices, bills, partial payments and credits, optional purchasing and inventory, and manually configured tax.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.5.0-preview: eleven sample businesses and a clearer setup
item.description: PHP Ledger 0.5.0-preview adds a clearer setup flow, responsive shell and eleven isolated sample business histories.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.3-preview: account ledgers and optional modules
item.description: Evaluate visible running balances, reviewed opening cutover, bank reconciliation, CSV exports and owner-controlled POS modules in PHP Ledger 0.1.3-preview.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.4-preview: clearer financial reports
item.description: Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet panels fit without horizontal scrolling. Account ledgers keep running balances and filters visible on tablets.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.5-preview: accessible sample checkout
item.description: Product-specific POS quantity labels, visible no-JavaScript controls and clearer information about the project, privacy and temporary demo.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.6-preview: PHP 8.2 support and country-neutral direction
item.description: A maintenance release with PHP 8.2 minimum, PHP 8.3 recommended, AGPL core licensing and clear country-neutral positioning.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.2.1-preview: connected reporting and four business histories
item.description: PHP Ledger 0.2.1-preview combines scoped read API/MCP connections, the accounting core and four sample businesses with reporting walkthroughs.

item.title: PHP Ledger 0.1.0-preview is available
item.description: The first PHP Ledger evaluation package includes company setup, receipts, expenses, balanced journals, reports and a sample cash point of sale.
